LOOK (Efeonce photographic language v1 — capture only, color is graded later): editorial documentary photograph of real professional work, shot on a full-frame camera. Neutral, accurate color balance with soft contrast and open, detailed shadows; NO color grade, NO teal-and-orange, NO split toning, NO HDR, NO crushed blacks, NO neon saturation. Light is motivated and directional: one soft window or lamp source from the side, clear modeling on faces, key-to-fill ratio around 3:1, never flat catalog light, never frontal flash, never ring light. If the scene allows, one small warm tungsten/amber practical light is visible in frame (a lamp, a bulb), subtle, never saturated orange. Real skin texture with pores and fine detail, real fabric weave, no plastic retouching, no beauty filter. People are genuinely engaged in the work (thinking, explaining, building), mostly not looking at the camera, no stock smiles, no thumbs up, no handshakes. Contemporary Santiago de Chile / Latin American professional setting, lived-in and specific, not a generic glass-and-plants stock office. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks anywhere in the image.

SCENE (register: craft portrait, vertical 4:5): A Chilean woman in her early thirties, a RevOps strategist, stands beside a large window in a converted older building in Providencia, Santiago, late afternoon. She wears a plain deep navy (#023c70) pique polo shirt with no logo, sleeves slightly pushed up. She looks slightly off-camera to the left, mid-thought, holding a marker loosely, a small genuine concentration in her expression. Soft window light comes from the left side and models her face; the right side of her face falls into gentle open shadow. Behind her, out of focus, a lived-in studio: a whiteboard with blurred diagrams, a wooden shelf, and one small warm amber desk lamp glowing as round soft bokeh. Background is lighter and warmer than her navy polo so the navy shirt clearly separates from the background. Camera: 105mm lens at f/2, eye level, sharp focus on her eyes, creamy natural background blur. Composition: she is placed in the lower-right two thirds of the frame; the upper-left third is calm, soft, out-of-focus wall and window light with no objects.

SCENE (register: work table, vertical 4:5): A working session between an agency team and a client in a meeting room in Las Condes, Santiago, overcast daylight from a big window on the right. Three people around a wooden table, seen from a slightly high three-quarter angle: a man in his forties in a navy (#023c70) softshell jacket with no logo, leaning forward and pointing at a laptop screen while explaining; a client woman in a light grey blazer listening, pen in hand; a younger man taking notes. The laptop screen shows an abstract pipeline chart with soft blue and grey bars and nodes, completely without legible text or numbers. On the table: printed sheets with handwritten sketches (no legible words), sticky notes in pale yellow and white, coffee cups, and one brass desk lamp with a warm tungsten bulb switched on, giving a small warm pool of light. Camera: 50mm lens at f/2.8, focus on the pointing hand and the explaining man's face, the others slightly softer. Composition: the table and people occupy the lower two thirds; the upper third is the softly out-of-focus room wall and window light.
